detail: Bharat Forge Limited has made a Qualified Institutions Placement of equity shares aggregating to approximately ₹2,000 crore. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised Kotak Mahindra Capital Company Limited, Morgan Stanley India Company Private Limited and Nomura Financial Advisory and Securities (India) Private Limited, the lead managers on this QIP. The transaction was led by Nikhil Naredi (Partner) and Devi Prasad Patel (Partner), with support from Harini Jambunathan (Senior Associate), Associates Dhanashree Singe, L Raghavi and Tanisha Taneja.
